This 0.07 hectare plot is my main maize field, so I will plant improved seed and apply both the subsidized NPK and urea I received through FISP, plus some manure I collected from our animals, because this crop must feed my family. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so I will depend on the rains and pull weeds by hand together with my children. We will work this plot ourselves over the season, about twenty days in total from planting to harvest, and I will not hire any outside labor since it is small enough for us to manage alone.
